::: hero-bio
I work across psychology, education, and digital health, with a particular interest in how evidence becomes useful to people and systems. My PhD examines school attendance problems from intervention research through to Australian cohort and education-system data.

### Beyond screen time

**Evidence-based assessment and early intervention for problematic digital use in young people**. This Australian Journal of General Practice article considers how clinicians can assess problematic digital use and respond early, without reducing the problem to screen time alone.

*Brown, T., Hunt, B., Conkey-Morrison, C., Burleigh, T. L., Stavropoulos, V., & Lubman, D. (2026).* *Australian Journal of General Practice*.

[View at journal website →](https://doi.org/10.31128/AJGP-11-25-7903){.about-link} [All publications →](research/publications.qmd){.about-link}
:::
:::

<script>
(function() {
  const card = document.getElementById('homepage-talk-card');
  if (!card) return;

  function parseTalks(yaml) {
    return yaml.trim().split(/\n\s*\n/).map(block => {
      const talk = {};
      block.split('\n').forEach(line => {
        const match = line.match(/^\s*(date|title|event|role|link):\s*(.*)$/);
        if (match) talk[match[1]] = match[2].trim();
      });
      return talk;
    }).filter(talk => talk.date && talk.title);
  }

  function updateTalkCard(talk) {
    const eventDate = new Date(`${talk.date}T23:59:59`);
    const upcoming = eventDate >= new Date();
    const label = upcoming ? 'Upcoming event' : 'Recent talk';
    const link = talk.link || '#';
    const title = document.getElementById('homepage-talk-title');
    const talkLink = document.getElementById('homepage-talk-link');
    const cta = document.getElementById('homepage-talk-cta');

    document.getElementById('homepage-talk-label').textContent = label;
    title.textContent = talk.title;
    document.getElementById('homepage-talk-description').textContent =
      `${talk.role} at ${talk.event} on ${new Date(`${talk.date}T12:00:00`).toLocaleDateString('en-AU', { day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' })}.`;
    talkLink.href = link;
    cta.href = link;
    cta.textContent = talk.link ? (upcoming ? 'Event details and registration →' : 'Event details →') : '';
    cta.hidden = !talk.link;
  }

  fetch('/data/talks.yml')
    .then(response => {
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Could not load talks');
      return response.text();
    })
    .then(parseTalks)
    .then(talks => {
      if (!talks.length) throw new Error('No talks found');
      const now = new Date();
      const upcoming = talks.filter(talk => new Date(`${talk.date}T23:59:59`) >= now)
        .sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date));
      updateTalkCard(upcoming[0] || talks.sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date))[0]);
    })
    .catch(() => {});
})();
</script>
